# ffxf_oidc_providers (Data Source)

Lists the OIDC providers configured on the account. Providers are managed in the console; use their id with ffxf_oidc_binding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_oidc_providers" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Attributes List) OIDC providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `audience` (String) Expected token audience.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is enabled.
- `id` (Number) Provider identifier.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer URL.
- `name` (String) Provider name.
